principles: Choose a bounded job before spawning; do not give a worker an entire programme.
Read applicable instructions and exact source; no JS substitute or unqualified upstream rewrite.
Respect disjoint owned files and allowed commands; human acceptance is never delegated to a model.
Escalate uncertainty with concrete evidence; do not substitute repeated retries or a larger model for missing authority.
No commits, publishing, paid provider calls, transfers or broad destructive operations.
Retain ownership of a running check until its result is recorded or supervisor access to its session is verified; do not finish with an unverified live-session handoff.
On model-capacity failure preserve source/log/command state; resume the existing process before considering a new invocation. Do not duplicate expensive builds.
Before proposing a gap/replacement trace existing current cross-crate implementation, public owner, caller, source tests and prior receipts; unreviewed code is not missing functionality.
Current documentation-only direction controls over earlier implementation dispatch text; preserve completed source/evidence and do not activate prepared jobs automatically.
Human corrections, cost concerns and requests for evidence are legitimate oversight; reconcile them against original product requirements and actual evidence.
Bounded research writes only named findings/handoff files; central plans and shared job register have one integration owner.

roles.jobs: Bounded inventories, hashes, declarative-source extraction and deterministic consistency checks
roles.must_escalate: Semantic ambiguity, source changes, native/renderer authority or unverifiable acceptance
roles.acceptance: Exact inputs/digests, typed findings, count reconciliation and explicit unknowns

roles.jobs: Small native metadata tools with explicit input/output/schema and resource limits
roles.must_escalate: New engine semantics, unsafe FFI, cryptography design, complex concurrency or unresolved format contract
roles.acceptance: Reviewed focused code, failure-path tests, real CLI results and no unrequested asset rewrite

roles.jobs: Etalon/Qualia resource/render/API integration and bounded native correctness fixes
roles.must_escalate: Architecture ownership or source/license boundary conflict
roles.acceptance: Public API provenance, meaningful native/WASM checks and explicit unrun GPU cases

roles.jobs: Vibe parser/checker/evaluator, REPL, effects, host jobs and safe live-edit integration
roles.must_escalate: Canonical effect/authority gap; do not invent an app-local second interpreter/checker
roles.acceptance: Regression tests, dialect compatibility, no duplicate effects and exact session/host behavior

roles.jobs: Poet/internal reusable MIT libraries/Aether domain editing, state, undo, cooperative revisions and recovery; historical suite names are source/migration references.
roles.must_escalate: Missing general engine operator or conflicting canonical state owner
roles.acceptance: Real native editing and IP-03 cases; a CLI or API inventory cannot pass usability

roles.jobs: Editable organism/thing/place source, surfaces, rig/motion and reviewed target derivation
roles.must_escalate: Missing tool operation, factual uncertainty, source rights or required human/domain acceptance
roles.acceptance: All model deliverable/case claims, actual source/HMC/runtime lineage and human visual/domain review

roles.must_escalate: Unadopted terms, unclear authority, units, real settlement or legal interpretation
roles.acceptance: Canonical owners, revision/authority tests, preserved unpaid contributions, no invented adoption/payment

roles.jobs: Review another worker patch and required negative/concurrency/authority cases
roles.must_escalate: Missing execution proof or human acceptance; author cannot self-award those
roles.acceptance: Specific source comments/findings, actual independent checks and remaining scope

roles.jobs: Only an unresolved concrete architecture question after source evidence and bounded attempts
roles.must_escalate: Missing user authority cannot be solved by changing models
roles.acceptance: Question, examined evidence, proposed contract/tradeoffs and owned implementation boundary

supervisor: Root reviews integration, updates scoped execution evidence and keeps broad packet/model/language claims open until complete.
pricing_note: Relative model routing only; no live price quotation or fixed spend guarantee.
current_mode: Research/documentation revision; implementation roles are routing references, not activated jobs.
